'''Galo Thriven''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[Thule/Legends|Thule]] who served as an elite [[Commando/Legends|commando]] in the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

A [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark sider]]<ref name="GatORW" /> who supported the Confederacy's aim to reform the "archaic" [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="TCSWEI137">{{CSWECite|I|137|Confederacy of Independent Systems (CIS)}}</ref> Thriven led an [[Galo Thriven's unit|elite unit]] of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] and successfully struck at vulnerable targets in the Republic during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="GatORW" /> Though trained to evade capture, he and his team were prepared to [[Death/Legends|kill themselves]] if captured alive to preserve Thule's status as a hidden [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]]<ref name="BoS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> and [[Vergence/Legends|Force nexus]]<ref name="TCSWE241">{{CSWECite|III|241-242|Thule}}</ref> and prevent information about the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] from falling into the wrong hands.<ref name="GatORW" />

As an elite soldier, Thriven wore a [[Jumpsuit/Legends|combat jumpsuit]], armed himself with a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] and [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]], and carried a number of [[Fragmentation grenade/Legends|fragmentation grenades]], [[Detonite/Legends|detonite]] charges, [[Electrobinoculars/Legends|electrobinoculars]], and [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]]. Like many of the residents of Thule, he was fluent in both [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] and the ancient [[Sith (language)|Sith language]].<ref name="GatORW" />
